intro.heroesevolved.quake.charge_subtitl: Pressure builds in your hands. Everything begins to tremble.
intro.heroesevolved.quake.release_subtit: An uncontrolled shockwave tears through the world around you.
intro.heroesevolved.flight.charge_subtit: The wind gathers beneath you. Gravity begins to let go.
intro.heroesevolved.flight.release_subti: Your first flight erupts in a column of wind.
intro.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.charg: Static crawls over your arms. The air hums with power.
intro.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.relea: Lightning crowns you as the charge bursts outward.
intro.heroesevolved.telekinesis.charge_s: Loose objects rise. An invisible force gathers around you.
intro.heroesevolved.telekinesis.release_: Your thoughts lift the world, then send it flying.
intro.heroesevolved.regeneration.charge_: Your wounds begin to close. Warmth spreads through your body.
intro.heroesevolved.regeneration.release: Your body repairs itself in a surge of life that reaches those nearby.
intro.heroesevolved.telepathy.charge_sub: Whispers that aren't yours crowd your head. You can hear them thinking.
intro.heroesevolved.telepathy.release_su: Every mind around you lights up. None of them can hide from you now.
intro.heroesevolved.radiation.charge_sub: Thirty seconds of uncontrolled heat. Stay back: the air around you is lethal.
intro.heroesevolved.radiation.release_su: A nuclear shockwave tears outward. The ground remains radioactive.
intro.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.charge_s: Frost spreads from your fingertips. Your breath turns to ice.
intro.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.release_: Everything around you freezes solid in a single heartbeat.
intro.heroesevolved.arrival: A FUTURE THAT MUST NOT HAPPEN
intro.heroesevolved.arrival_subtitle: Time fractures around you. The city is evacuating.
intro.heroesevolved.blast_subtitle: The shockwave is coming. Your power reacts...
intro.heroesevolved.return_subtitle: You pulled everyone back before the blast reached you.
advancement.heroesevolved.special.title: Special
screen.heroesevolved.no_power: You have not discovered a power yet. Powers stir in people during an Eclipse - watch the sky.
screen.heroesevolved.dormant_hint: Your power is dormant. It will awaken on its own when your life is in danger.
screen.heroesevolved.no_skills: This power has no active skills.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_dormant: This power must awaken before it can gain Mastery.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_pow: Using your powers: 1 Mastery per energy spent.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_com: Defeating hostile mobs: tougher foes are worth more.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_act: Staying active: a small trickle over time.
hud.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot_crea: Hold Shift: preserve this area as a Past you can visit later.
hud.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot_trav: Travel to your snapshot with nearby friends, or return home.
ability.heroesevolved.regeneration.passi: Wounds close on their own over time, faster at higher levels. From Level 2 your body flushes poisons.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_rapid_: Instantly heal, purge toxins and put out flames.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_blood_: Heal whoever you look at with your blood. Burns the undead.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_indest: Feel no pain: no fall damage or knockback, and less harm.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_resurr: Passive. Return from death - once per cooldown.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_healin: For 10s, everyone near you heals each second. The undead burn.
ability.heroesevolved.flight.passive: Double-tap Jump to fly. Scroll up/down in the air to select speed; each level unlocks a faster setting. Hold Forward to travel.
action.heroesevolved.flight_toggle.desc: Take to the air or drop out of flight. Drains energy while flying.
action.heroesevolved.flight_launch.desc: Rocket skyward, then burst forward where you look.
action.heroesevolved.flight_cyclone.desc: Circle at speed to whip up a tornado that hurls enemies.
action.heroesevolved.flight_skyward_grab: Seize someone and fly off with them. Press again to hurl them.
action.heroesevolved.flight_dive_bomb.de: Plunge along your gaze and land as a sonic shockwave. No fall damage.
Time slows around you on its own when you first awaken.
action.heroesevolved.time_blink.desc: Teleport onto the block you look at. Level 2: Sneak to bring someone.
action.heroesevolved.time_slow.desc: Slow everything around you - mobs, arrows, falling blocks.
action.heroesevolved.time_stop.desc: Freeze time nearby. Your blows land all at once when it resumes.
action.heroesevolved.time_rewind.desc: Rewind 15 seconds: restore nearby changed blocks, return to your past position, and regain lost health. Records blocks within 32 blocks of you.
ability.heroesevolved.quake.passive: Vibrations cushion your landings: 20% less fall damage per level. Overexertion fractures your arms.
action.heroesevolved.quake_shockwave.des: Palm blast that hurls foes and reflects arrows. Jump and fire to launch opposite your aim; aim down to take off.
Punch the ground to send out a ring of force. In midair, plunge first.
Feel heartbeats: nearby creatures glow through walls, only for you.
action.heroesevolved.quake_earthquake.de: Shake the ground for seconds, then release an aftershock. Shift ends early.
action.heroesevolved.quake_blast.desc: HOLD: a two-handed beam that drains energy per second. Jump to launch opposite your aim, then steer in midair. Aim down to rise.
ability.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.pas: Lightning recharges you instead of hurting you; storms speed up your energy. Level 2: melee hits shock and stun. Beware water.
action.heroesevolved.electro_chain_light: A bolt that leaps to more foes as you level. Wet targets take extra.
action.heroesevolved.electro_ball_lightn: A drifting orb that lashes nearby foes, then bursts on contact.
action.heroesevolved.electro_thunderstri: Call lightning down where you point. It never sets the land alight.
action.heroesevolved.electro_ride_the_li: Become a streak of current and dash forward, shocking what you pass.
action.heroesevolved.electro_storm_surge: Strike everything around you at once. Far stronger in a storm.
ability.heroesevolved.telekinesis.passiv: Loose items drift toward you. Overexertion brings a blinding migraine.
Tear the weapon from a mob's hands and draw in loose items.
ability.heroesevolved.radiation.passive: Injury and emissions build Stress. Your orange glow intensifies; above 60% radiation leaks. At 100%, vent within 3 seconds or lose control. Your own blast and fallout spare you.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_radiant_t: Scorch and irradiate a target, boil water, thaw ice, or melt iron doors and bars.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_pulse.des: Emit toxic radiation. Shift emits a bright, blinding flash instead.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_meltdown_: Concentrate and vent built-up Stress through a focused heat beam.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_exploding: Release a destructive 24-block nuclear shockwave and one minute of fallout. Shift cancels a voluntary charge; lost control cannot be canceled.
ability.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.passiv: Frozen-solid targets shatter when hit. Your punches chill, water freezes underfoot (sneak to stop), you can't freeze, but fire hurts more.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_frost_bolt.des: A crystal lance chills and slows its target. Repeated hits encase it in ice. Freezes water on impact.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_flash_freeze.d: Touch a creature to freeze it solid. Hit it again to shatter it.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_ice_wall.desc: Raise a wall of packed ice in front of you. It melts away in time.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_glacial_spikes: A line of ice spikes bursts from the ground, launching foes.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_blizzard.desc: A 20-block dome of cold follows you, freezing nearby creatures immediately and temporarily icing exposed terrain. Everything thaws afterward.
ability.heroesevolved.telepathy.passive: You hear hostile thoughts: a whispered warning when something unseen starts hunting you. Overexertion floods you with voices.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_read_mind: Hear thoughts; what it hunts glows. Villagers dream of a city that isn't built yet...
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_suggestio: "You don't see me." Hostiles forget you; peaceful mobs follow you.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_mind_link: Link with nearby players: see each other through walls, feel each other's pain.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_puppet.de: Seize a hostile mind and turn it on its own kind. Shift releases it.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_nightmare: Trap a mind in terror: it flees blindly and suffers each second.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_push.de: Shove everything in front of you. Hitting a wall hurts.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_grip.de: Hold a creature in the air, choking. Press again to hurl it.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_bullet_: Freeze incoming projectiles, then fling them where you look.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_storm.d: Lift everyone around you into the air, then slam them down.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_emp.desc: Disable redstone electronics within 16 blocks for 10 seconds. Blocks and inventories remain intact.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.watched: You feel as though someone has been watching you. The feeling follows you home.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.figure: A dark figure stands at the edge of your vision. He isn't looking at the landscape.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.recognized: The stranger tilts his head. His eyes follow every small movement of your hands.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.gone: You look again. The figure is gone. You aren't sure when he moved.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.hunt: The ticking stops. The stranger raises one hand. He has finished watching.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.hold: An unseen pressure tightens around you. Hurt him, break his sightline, or get away before he understands your power.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.acquired: His expression changes. He understands. Your power is still yours, but now he knows how to use it too.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.witness: You see recognition in the watchmaker's eyes. He has learned another ability.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.future: The watchmaker has learned the glowing man's heat. The future from the visions is drawing closer.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.defeated: The hunter falls. For the first time in a long while, you cannot hear the ticking.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.sense: You sense a cold, calculating mind to the %s. A terrible hunger hides behind the silence. Sylar is nearby.
